options_mr: सुरुवातीला राज्यघटनेत अनुसूचित जाती व अनुसूचित जमाती यांच्यासाठी अनुच्छेद 338 नुसार विशेष अधिकारी नेमण्याची तरतूद होती.
1990 च्या 65 व्या घटनादुरुिीनुसार एक सदस्यीय पद्धतीचे रूपान्तर बहुसदस्यीय अशा अनुसूचित जाती आणि अनुसूचित जमातीसाठी राष्टरीय आयोगामध्ये करण्यांत आले.

questions.question_en:
Which one of the following statements about National
Commission for scheduled castes is incorrect?
questions.option_1_en: Initially, the Constitution provided for the appointment of special officer under Article 338 for SCs and STs.
questions.option_2_en: 65th Amendment of 1990 replaced the one member system with a multimember National Commission for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
मंत्रिपररषद (Council of Ministers) आणि कॅ बिनेट (Cabinet)
यांच्यातील फरकाबाबत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या.
(a) संपूणय राज्यघटनेमध्ये 'मंत्रिपररषद' हाच शब्दप्रयोग वापरण्यांत
आलेला आहे, के वळ अनुच्छेद-352 मध्ये 'कॅ बिनेट' हा शब्द
वापरलेला आहे.
(b) राज्यघटनेने संपूणय सत्ता ही 'कॅ बिनेट' कडे सुपुतय केलेली आहे,
परंतु प्रत्यक्षात ही सत्ता मंत्रिपररषदेद्वारा वापरली जाते.
(c) मंत्रिपररषदेत कॅ बिनेट मंत्री, राज्य मंत्री, उपमंत्री यांचा समावेश
असतो तर दुसऱ्या बाजुस कॅ बिनेट मध्ये के वळ कॅ बिनेट दजायचे
मंत्री असतात.
वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/त?
questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements about the difference
between Council of Ministers and Cabinet.
(a) Throughout the constitution the term 'Council of
Ministers' has been used, only in Article 352 the term
'Cabinet' has been used.
(b) The constitution vests all the powers in the Cabinet but
actually these powers are exercised by the Council of
Ministers.
(c) The Council of Ministers shall comprise of three types
of Ministers viz. Cabinet Ministers, State and Deputy
Ministers. The Cabinet on the other hand consists of only
Cabinet Ministers.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

दिवस किं वा अधिवेशन संपल्यानंतर 60 दिवस या कालावधीत
संसद सदस्याला अटक करता येत नाही.
(d) सभागृहाच्या प्रमुखाच्या परवानगीशिवाय सभागृहाच्या
आवारात कोणत्याही व्यस्तक्तला अटक करता येत नाही अथवा

questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements regarding
Parliamentary Privileges :
(a) Parliamentary Privileges are special rights, immunities
and exemptions enjoyed by two Houses of Parliament.
(b) The Constitution has also extended the Parliamentary
Privileges to the President of India because he is also an
integral part of the Parliament.
(c) Members of Parliament cannot be arrested during the
session and 60 days before the beginning and 60 days
after the end of a session.
(d) No person can be arrested, and no legal process [Civil
or Criminal] can be served within the precincts of the
House without the permission of the Presiding Officer.
Which of the above statement/s is/are correct?

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
भारतीय राज्यघटनेच्या कलम 370 बाबत खालील विधाने विचारात

(b) जम्मू आणि कास्तिरला विशेष दजाय प्रदान करण्यासाठी

(c) त्या कलमाने जम्मू आणि कास्तिर राज्याच्या संदभायत संसदेच्या
वैधानिक अधिकारांवर बंधने घातली होती.
(d) राष्टरपतीच्या स्वाक्षरीने निगयमित अध्यक्षीय आदेशामुळे 370 वे
कलम हे राज्यघटनेतून पूणयपणे वगळण्यांत आले आहे.
वरीलपैकी कोणती विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/त ?
questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements about Article-370 of the
Indian Constitution:
(a) Article-370 was incorporated in part XIX of the
Constitution.

special status to J & K.

totally deleted Article-370 from the Constitution.
Which of the statements above is/are correct?

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
राज्यघटनेतील कलम 21 संदभायत खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान
/विधाने बिनचूक आहेत ?
(a) कलम 21 नुसार, कायद्याने प्रथथापित के लेल्या काययपद्धती
खेरीज कोणत्याही व्यक्तीचे जीवित व व्यस्तक्तस्वातंत्र् हिरावून घेतले
जाणार नाही.
(b) कलम 21 नुसार मिळणारे हे संरक्षण के वळ काययकारी
मंडळाच्या मनमानी कृ तीविरोधात असून कायदेमंडळाच्या
मनमानी कृ तीविरोधात उपलब्ध होत नाही.
(c) हा अधिकार नागररक व परदेशीय नागररक दोहोनं ाही उपलब्ध

questions.question_en:
Which of the following statements is/are correct about
Article 21 of the Constitution of India ?
(a) Article 21 declares that no person shall be deprived of
his life or personal liberty except according to procedure
established by law.
(b) The protection under Article 21 is available only against
arbitrary executive action and not against arbitrary
legislative action.
(c) This right is available to both citizens and non-citizens.

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
भारतातील 'अंदाज समिती' बाबत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
(a) भारतातील 'अंदाज समिती' ही ििटीश नमुन्यावर आधाररत
आहे आणि ती 1952 साली तत्कालीन सभापती जी.व्ही.
मावळणकर यांच्या शिफारशीनुसार थथापन करण्यांत आली.
(b) अंदाज समितीमध्ये संसदेच्या दोन्ही सभागृहातील 30 सदस्य
असतात.
(c) तिच्या अध्यक्षाची निवड ही समिती सदस्यांकडून होते.
(d) प्रशासनात काययक्षमता आणि काटकसर घडवून आणण्यासाठी
पर्यायी धोरण सुचविणे हे अंदाज समितीचे कायय आहे.
वरीलपैकी कोणते/कोणती विधान/ने बिनचूक आहे/त ?
questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements about 'Estimates
Committee' in India:
(a) The Estimates Committee in India has been modelled
on the British pattern and was created in 1952 on the
suggestion of G.V. Mavalankar, the then speaker.
(b) The Estimates Committee consists of 30 members from
both Houses of Parliament.
(c) Its Chairman is elected by the members of the
committee.
(d) The function of Estimates committee is to suggest
alternative policies in order to bring about efficiency and
economy in administration.
Which of the statements above is/are correct?

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
'सवय शिक्षा अभियाना' च्या संदभायत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
(a) त्याचा प्रारंभ 2001 मध्ये झाला.
(b) त्याचा प्रारंभ हा प्राथमिक शिक्षणाचे सावयत्रिकरण साध्य
करण्यासाठी झालेला आहे.
(c) 'पढें भारत बढें भारत' हा सवय शिक्षा अभियानाचा उप-काययक्रम
आहे.
(d) 'शिक्षण' (Shikshan) या नावाचे सरकारी द्वार (portal) हे सवय

been launched to monitor the SSA programme.

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
भारतीय वृत्तपत्र पररषदे (Press Council of India) संदभायत
खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
(a) पररषद वृत्तपत्रे, वृत्त एजिीज, संपादक आणि वातायहर यांना
मागयदशयक तत्त्ांचा भंग के ल्यास दंडीत करु शकते.
(b) पररषदेचे निणयय हे अंतीम असतात आणि त्याविरुद्ध
न्यायालयात अपील करता येत नाही.
(c) पररषदेला इलेक्टरॉनिक माध्यमांच्या कायायचे पररक्षण करण्याचा
देखील अधिकार आहे.
वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/त?
questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements about Press Council of
India:
(a) It can penalize newspapers, news agencies, editors and
journalists for violation of the guidelines.
(b) Its decisions are final and cannot be appealed before a
court of law.
(c) It has a power to review the functioning of the
electronic media also.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
खालील कथने लक्षात घ्या :
(a) VVPAT चा अथय वोटर वेररफायबल पेपर ऑडिट टरेल असा
आहे.
(b) VVPAT स्लीप मध्ये उमेदवाराचा अनुक्रमांक, नांव व चिन्ह
याचा समावेश असतो.
(c) VVPAT स्लीप ही पारदशयक स्तखडकीमधुन 5 सेकंदापयंत बघता
येवू शकते.
वरीलपैकी योग्य कथने कोणती आहेत ?
questions.question_en:

(a) VVPAT stands for Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail.
(b) VVPAT slip contains serial number, name and symbol of
the candidate.
(c) VVPAT slip remains exposed through a transparent
window for about 5 seconds.
Which are the correct statements from above?

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
खालील कथने लक्षात घ्या :
(a) पारूर विधानसभा मतदारसंघामध्ये सवयप्रथम इलेक्टरानिक
मतदान यंत्राचा वापर करण्यात आला.
(b) इलेक्टरॉनिक मतदान यंत्राचा सवयप्रथम वापर मे, 1982 मध्ये
करण्यात आला.
(c) निवडणुकीमध्ये EVM चा वापर करण्याचा भारताचा निवडणूक
आयोगाला अधिकार देण्याबाबतचे नवीन कलम 61 A हे डिसेंबर,
1989 मध्ये लोकप्रतिनिधीत्व कायदा, 1951 मध्ये जोडण्यात आले.
वरीलपैकी कोणती कथने योग्य आहेत ?
questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements:
(a) The Electronic Voting Machines (EVM) were used for
the first time in Parur Assembly Constituency.
(b) The Electronic Voting Machines (EVM) were used for
the first time in May, 1982.
(c) In December, 1989 a new section 61 A was inserted in
the Representation of the People Act, 1951 empowering
the Election Commission of India to use EVM in elections.
Which are the correct statements from the above?

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
राजकीय पक्षांसंबंधी खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
(a) सध्या भारतात सात राष्टरीय पक्ष आहेत.
(b) राजकीय पक्षाची राष्टरीय अथवा राज्य पक्ष म्हणून मिळालेली
मान्यता के वळ सलग दोन विधानसभा अथवा दोन लोकसभा
निवडणुकीत अट पूणय करण्यास अपयशी झाला तरच तो पक्ष
आपला असलेला दजाय गमावतो.
(c) याचाच अथय असा की, पक्ष आपला दजाय पुढील येत्या
निवडणुकीतील कामगिरी शिवाय कायम राखतात.
questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements regarding political
parties in India:
(a) At present, there are seven National parties in India.
(b) Once recognised as a National or a State party, a
political party loses its given status only if it fails to fulfil
any of the conditions for two successive Assembly or two
successive Lok Sabha elections.
(c) That means a party retains that status irrespective of its
performance in the next elections.
questions.option_1_en: Statements (a) and (b) are correct and (c) is false.
questions.option_2_en: Statements (b) and (c) are correct and (a) is false.
questions.option_3_en: Statements (a) and (c) are correct and (b) is false.
options_en: Statements (a) and (b) are correct and (c) is false.
Statements (b) and (c) are correct and (a) is false.
Statements (a) and (c) are correct and (b) is false.

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
सध्या, भारतीय राजकीय पक्षांची प्रमुख वैशिष्ट्ये खालील प्रमाणे :
(a) बहुपक्ष पद्धती (b) प्रादेशिक पक्षांचे वचयस्व (c) प्रभावी विरोधी

योग्य पयायय :

At present, main features of the Indian Political Party
system are:
(a) Multi party system (b) Dominance of regional parties

Correct

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
कोठारी आयोगाने अनुसूचित जमातीच्या शिक्षणाबाबत कोणत्या
शिफारशी के ल्या आहेत ?
(a) कररअर किं वा नोकरीभिमुख अभ्यासक्रमांवर भर दिला
पाहिजे.
(b) शिक्षणातील लिंग विषमता दूर करण्यावर अधिक लक्ष कें द्रित
के ले पाहिजे.
(c) पालकांमध्ये दृष्टीकोन बदल घडवून आणण्यासाठी पथनाय,
शिबीरे, समुपदेशन सत्र यासारख्ा जागृती मोहिमा.
(d) जे, आदिवासी संस्कृती आणि पद्धती समजून घेतात आणि
त्यांचा आदर करतात अशा शिक्षकांची थथानिक पातळीवर भरती
के ली पाहिजे.
वरीलपैकी कोणत्या शिफारशी बरोबर आहेत ?
questions.question_en:

(a) Emphasis should be given to career or job oriented
courses.
(b) Greater focus should be given to removing gender
disparity in education.
(c) Awareness campaigns like street drama, camps,
counselling session to bring attitudinal change in parents.
(d) Teachers should be locally recruited who understand
and respect tribal culture and practices.
Which of the recommendations given above are correct?

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
भारतीय लोक प्रशासन संथथा (IIPA) संबंधित खालील विधाने
लक्षात घ्या आणि कोणते विधान/ने सत्य आहेत ते ओळखा.
(a) IIPA ची थथापना 1955 मध्ये, पॉल एच. अॅपलबी यांनी याच वषी
के लेल्या सवेक्षणाच्या शिफारशीच्या आधारे करण्यात आली.
(b) IIPA चा प्रमुख प्रशिक्षण काययक्रम म्हणजे 12 महिन्यांचा
APPPA आहे.
(c) श्री. शंकरराव बी. चव्हाण, 1981-2004 दरयान IIPA चे अध्यक्ष
(Chairman) होते.
questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements about Indian Institute
of Public Administration (IIPA). Which of the statement/s
is/are true?
(a) It was established in 1955, on the recommendation of
survey carried out by Paul H. Appleby in the same year.
(b) A 12 months flagship training programme of IIPA is
named as APPPA.
(c) Shri. Shankarrao B. Chavan was the Chairman of IIPA
during 1981-2004.

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
मूळ भारतीय संविधानात 'जिल्हा' या संज्ञेचा उल्लेख फक्त कलम
............... मध्ये ............... संदभायने होता.
questions.question_en:
Originally the Constitution of India made no mention of
the term 'District' except in Article ............... which
mentioned the term as ...............

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
भारतीय संविधानाच्या कलम 310 मध्ये अंतभायव नसलेले विधान/ने
आहे/त :
(a) कें द्राच्या नागरी सेवेत काययरत असलेल्या व्यक्तीच्यं ा
सेवाशतीबाबत नियमन करण्याचे अधिकार संसदेला आहेत.
(b) कें द्राच्या नागरी सेवेतील व्यक्ती राष्टरपतीचं ी मजी असेपयंत
पदावर राहू शकतात.
(c) राज्यातील नागरी सेवेतील व्यक्ती त्या राज्याच्या राज्यपालांची
मजी असेपयंत पदावर राहू शकतात.
questions.question_en:
The statement/s not included in Article 310 of the Indian
Constitution is/are
(a) It empowers parliament to regulate the condition of
services of the persons appointed to Public Services under
centre.
(b) The Civil Servants of the centre hold office during the
pleasure of the President.
(c) The Civil Servants of the state hold office during the
pleasure of the Governor of the State.

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
प्रशासनशास्त्रामध्ये वतयनवादी अभ्यासाला महत्वाचे थथान मिळवून

questions.question_en:
Which thinker is credited with giving important place to
behavioural studies in Administration ?

एक सावयजनिक धोरण मूल्यमापन पद्धती म्हणून ............... चा

करण्यासाठी के ला जातो.
questions.question_en:

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
योग्य कथने ओळखा :
(a) सनदी (नागरी) सेवांची विभागणी तीन गटात होवू शकते:
अस्तखल भारतीय सेवा, कें द्रीय सेवा आणि राज्य सेवा.
(b) कें द्रीय सेवेतील अधिकारी हे एकाच खात्यापुरते मयायदित
असतात तर अस्तखल भारतीय सेवेतील अधिकाऱ्यांच्या नेमणूका
अनेक खात्यांमध्ये होवू शकतात.
(c) भारतीय प्रशासकीय सेवेतील सदस्यांच्या नेमणूका अशा
पदावर के ल्या जावू शकतात जेथे सवयसाधारण पययवेक्षण स्वरूपाची
कतयव्ये पार पाडावयाची असतात तर कें द्रीय सेवेतील अधिकारी
बहुदा विशेष स्वरूपाच्या कायायसाठी नियुक्त के लेले असतात.
questions.question_en:
Identify the correct statements:
(a) The Civil Services can be divided into three groups: All
India Services (AIS), Central Services and State Services.
(b) The officers of Central Services are confined to a single
department, while AIS Officers can be posted to a number
of departments.
(c) The members of IAS can be appointed to any office
calling for duties of General Supervisory nature, while
Officers of the Central Services are employed in jobs of
specialised nature.

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
(a) ऑपरेशन फ्लड म्हणून ओळखली जाणारी धवल (श्वेत) क्रांती
(White Revolution) भारतात 1960 मध्ये सुरु झाली.
(b) वगीस कु ररयन हे धवल क्रांतीचे जनक होते.
(c) वगीस कु ररयन यांनी त्यांचे मित्र एच्. एम्. दलाया यांच्यासह दूध
पावडर बनवण्याचा शोध लावला.
(d) भारतातील धवल क्रांतीचे तीन टप्पे होते.
वरीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत ?
questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements:
(a) The 'White Revolution', known as 'Operation Flood'
was launched in 1960 in India.
(b) Verghese Kurien was the father of the 'White
Revolution'.
(c) Verghese Kurien, along with his friend H.M. Dalaya
invented the process of making milk powder.
(d) There were three phases of the White Revolution in
India.
Which of the statements given above are correct?

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
'हररत क्रांतीच्या' पररणामाबाबत खालीलपैकी कोणती विधाने
बिनचूक आहेत ?
(a) अन्नधान्याची दरडोई निव्वळ उपलब्धता वाढली आहे.
(b) नॉन-फू ड पिकांमधील हाय इस्तडंग व्हरायटी बियाणे पुरेसे
विकसित के ले गेले नाहीत.
(c) हररत क्रांती ही मुख्त्वे 'तांदूळ क्रांती' म्हणून ओळखली जाते.
(d) मोठ्या प्रमाणावर शेतीचे यांत्रिकीकरण.
questions.question_en:
Which of the following statements regarding impacts of
'Green Revolution' are correct?
(a) The per capita net availability of food-grains also
increased.
(b) The high yielding variety seeds in the non-food crops
were not developed sufficiently.
(c) The Green Revolution in India is largely known as the
'Rice Revolution'.
(d) Large scale farm mechanization.

questions.question_mr:

(a) सरकार व नागररक (b) सरकार व कायदेमंडळ (c) सरकार
व उद्योगधंदे (d) सरकार व सरकार (e) सरकार व कमयचारी
questions.question_en:

questions.question_mr:

questions.question_en:

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
भारतात लोक प्रशासनाच्या उदय-विकासाबाबत खालीलपैकी
कोणते विधान चुकीचे आहे ?
questions.option_1_mr: 1937 मध्ये मद्रास विद्यापीठाने लोक प्रशासनातील डिप्लोमा कोसय सुरु के ला.
questions.option_2_mr: 1938 मध्ये अलाहाबाद विद्यापीठाने थथानिक स्व-शासनातील डिप्लोमा कोसय सुरु के ला.
questions.option_3_mr: 1950 मध्ये प्रा. एम्.पी. शमाय यांच्या सुचनेवरुन नागपूर विद्यापीठात लोक प्रशासन आणि थथानिक स्व-शासन असा पररपूणय विभाग थथापन करण्यांत आला.
options_mr: 1937 मध्ये मद्रास विद्यापीठाने लोक प्रशासनातील डिप्लोमा कोसय सुरु के ला.
1938 मध्ये अलाहाबाद विद्यापीठाने थथानिक स्व-शासनातील डिप्लोमा कोसय सुरु के ला.
1950 मध्ये प्रा. एम्.पी. शमाय यांच्या सुचनेवरुन नागपूर विद्यापीठात लोक प्रशासन आणि थथानिक स्व-शासन असा पररपूणय विभाग थथापन करण्यांत आला.
questions.question_en:
Which one of the following statements regarding
evolution of Public Administration in India is incorrect?
questions.option_1_en: In 1937, University of Madras introduced a diploma course in Public Administration.
questions.option_2_en: In 1938, University of Allahabad launched a diploma course in Local Self Government.
questions.option_3_en: In 1950, at the suggestion of Prof. M.P. Sharma a full- fledged Department of Public Administration and Local Self Government was established in Nagpur University.
options_en: In 1937, University of Madras introduced a diploma course in Public Administration.
In 1938, University of Allahabad launched a diploma course in Local Self Government.
In 1950, at the suggestion of Prof. M.P. Sharma a full- fledged Department of Public Administration and Local Self Government was established in Nagpur University.
questions.correct_answer_mr: 1950 मध्ये प्रा. एम्.पी. शमाय यांच्या सुचनेवरुन नागपूर विद्यापीठात लोक प्रशासन आणि थथानिक स्व-शासन असा पररपूणय विभाग थथापन करण्यांत आला.
questions.correct_answer_en: In 1950, at the suggestion of Prof. M.P. Sharma a full- fledged Department of Public Administration and Local Self Government was established in Nagpur University.

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
"कें द्र सरकारच्या अधिकृ त व्यवहार प्रक्रियेशी संपकय ठेवणारा
कॅ बिनेट सचिव हा पंतप्रधानांचे डोळे व कान असतो, पण तो
पंतप्रधानांच्या वतीने राखण करणारा राखणदार किं वा पययवेक्षक
मात्र नसतो. कॅ बिनेट सचिव हे मंत्रालयाच्या बाबतीत सल्लागारी
(Staff) पद आहे, काययकारी (Line) पद नाही, त्याचे कायय साहाय्य
करणे आहे-पययवेक्षण करणे नव्हे" असे कॅ बिनेट सचिवाच्या
भूमिके बाबत कोणी म्हटले आहे ?
questions.question_en:
Who, on the role of a Cabinet Secretary observed that
"The Cabinet Secretary provides the eyes and ears for the
Prime Minister to keep in touch with the process of official
business in the Central Government, but he is in no sense
a watchdog or an invigilator on behalf of the Prime
Minister. A Cabinet Secretary's is a very general staff
function, not a line function in relation to the Ministries.
His business is to help, not to oversee".

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
जोड्या लावा :
आयोग/समिती: (a) मेकॉले समिती, (b) अॅचिसन आयोग, (c)
इस्तस्लंग्टन आयोग, (d) ली आयोग
शिफारस: (i) वैधानिक नागरी सेवा भरतीची पद्धत रद्द करावी, (ii)
नागरी सेवांमध्ये भरती करण्यासाठी खुली स्पधाय परीक्षा पद्धत सुरु
करण्यात यावी, (iii) लोकसेवा आयोगाची थथापना करण्यात यावी,
(iv) थेट भरती होणाऱ्यांसाठी दोन वषांचा पररविक्षाधीन कालावधी
असावा
questions.question_en:
Match the pairs:
Commission/Committee: (a) Macaulay Committee, (b)
Aitchison Commission, (c) Islington Commission, (d) Lee
Commission
Recommendations: (i) The Statutory Civil Service System of
recruitment should be abolished, (ii) An open competition
system should be adopted for recruitment to the Civil
Services, (iii) A Public Service Commission should be
established, (iv) There should be a probationary period of
two years for direct recruits

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
मुख् सचिव आणि मंत्रिमंडळ सचिव यांच्या संदभायत खालीलपैकी
कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत ?
(a) दोघांची काये आणि अधिकार समान आहेत.
(b) दोघेही त्यांच्या संबंधित मंत्रिमंडळाचे सचिव असतात.
(c) दोघेही त्यांच्या संबंधित मंत्रिमंडळाच्या निणययांच्या
अंमलबजावणीचे पययवेक्षण करतात.
(d) मंत्रिमंडळ सचिव पदाची सुरुवात कें द्रीय िरावर झाली, तर
मुख् सचिव पदाची सुरुवात राज्य िरावर झाली.
questions.question_en:
Which of the following statements about Chief Secretary
and Cabinet Secretary are correct?
(a) The powers and functions of both are equal.
(b) Both are Secretaries to their respective Cabinets.
(c) Both supervise the implementation of the decisions of
their respective cabinets.
(d) The office of Cabinet Secretary originated at the
Central Level, while that of Chief Secretary at the State
Level.

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr:
'जिल्हा दंडाधिकारी' या नात्याने जिल्हाधिकारी यांच्या अधिकारात
खालीलपैकी कोणते कायय येते ?
(a) कोणीही हक्क सांगितलेले नाही, अशा मालमत्तेची विल्हेवाट
लावणे.
(b) मुद्रांक शुल्क अधिनियमाची अंमलबजावणी करणे.
(c) करमणूक कर अधिनियमाची अंमलबजावणी करणे.
(d) वृत्तपत्र अधिनियमाची (Press Act) अंमलबजावणी करणे.
(e) कारागृहांची तपासणी करणे.
questions.question_en:
The District Collector in his capacity as a 'District
Magistrate' performs following functions.
(a) To order disposal of unclaimed property.
(b) To enforce Stamp Duty Act.
(c) To enforce Entertainment Tax Act.
(d) To enforce press Act.
(e) To inspect the Jails.

(a) सचिवालयीन कामाबाबत कायदेमंडळास साहाय्य करणे.

Which of the following are the functions of the state

questions.subject: CSAT / Maths & Reasoning
questions.question_mr: खालील विधानांपैकी योग्य विधान ओळखा :
questions.option_1_mr: सुरुवातीला सावयजनिक उपक्रम समिती मध्ये 15 सदस्य होते, लोकसभेतून 10 आणि राज्यसभेतून 5 असे.

questions.option_4_en: All of the above 8 | R17 Read the following passage carefully and answer the Q. No. 6 to Q. No. 10. On top of nuclear war, in the coming decades humankind will face a new existential threat that hardly registered on the political radars in 1964 : ecological collapse. Humans are destabilising the global biosphere on multiple fronts. We are taking more and more resources out of the environment, while pumping back into it enormous quantities of waste and poison, thereby changing the composition of the soil, the water and the atmosphere. We are hardly even aware of the myriad ways in which we disrupt the delicate ecological balance that has been shaped over millions of years. Consider, for example, the use of phosphorus as a fertiliser. In small quantities it is an essential nutrient for the growth of plants. But in excessive amounts it becomes toxic. Modern industrial farming is based on artificially fertilising the fields with plenty of phosphorus, but the high-phosphorus run-off from the farms subsequently poisons rivers, lakes and oceans, with a devastating impact on marine life. A farmer growing corn in Iowa might thus inadvertently kill fish in the Gulf of Mexico. As a result of such activities, habitats are degraded, animals and plants are becoming extinct, and entire ecosystems such as the Australian Great Barrier Reef and the Amazon rainforest might be destroyed. For thousands of years Homo sapiens behaved as an ecological serial killer; now it is morphing into an ecological mass murderer. If we continue with our present course it will cause not just the annihilation of a large percentage of all life forms, but it might also sap the foundations of human civilisation. Most threatening of all is the prospect of climate change. Humans have been around for hundreds of thousands of years, and have survived numerous ice ages and warm spells. However, agriculture, cities and complex societies have existed for no more than 10,000 years. During this period, known as the Holocene, Earth’s climate has been relatively stable. Any deviation from Holocene standards will present human societies with enormous challenges they never encountered before. It will be like conducting an open-ended experiment on billions of human guinea pigs. Even if human civilisation eventually adapts to the new conditions, who knows how many victims might perish in the process of adaptation.

questions.question_en: Read the following passage and answer the questions 11 to 15. “Global Environmental Changes” Human population has been growing rapidly. It has crossed 6 billion mark in 1999. Per capita consumption of resources has increased to many times (e.g. 25 litres of fresh water to 250 litres/day). This has strained in life system of earth and brought about a number of environmental changes on a global scale. i. Forest cover of the world was 50% of land area in the decade of 1900, 40% of land in the decade of 1950s and less than 30% in the decade of 2000. It has resulted in increased desertification, irregular rainfall, more floods, increased soil erosion, loss of perrenial flow in rivers, reduced ground water and therefore, increased drought. 11 | R17 ii. More and more people are migrating to towns and cities. There is rise in the number of slums and consequently, an increase in filth and pollution. iii. Increase in quantity of solid wastes. iv. Rise in industrial wastes and pollutants. v. Increased passage of fertilizers and pesticides in water bodies and food chains. vi. High rate of consumption of fossil fuels is adding CO2, SO2 and a number of other gases and chemicals into the atmosphere causing acid rain, ozone depletion, global warming and frequent foggy weather. Green House Effect is a warming effect found in a green house by allowing solar radiations to pass in, but preventing long wave heat radiations to pass out due to glass panes, water vapours and carbon dioxide. Because of it, green houses are used for growing tropical plants in temperate areas. Green house warm up is similar to the inside of a car parked in the sun for an hour or so. Dusty/humid/cloudy nights are warmer due to this phenomenon.

पण साधा एक अ राचा श ददे खील के वढा गहन आशय क शकतो, हे अगद अलीकडे वेगवेग या घटनांनी मा या नदशनाला आणून दले. मा या भाचीची मुलगी. माझी छोट नात. वय तीन-साडेतीन वष. ती मराठ छान बोलते. वया या मानाने अथपूण आ ण अगद ठसके बाज. ह ली तला एक श द सापडला आहे. तो हणजे ‘का ?’ ती सारखे वचारत असते. मी कोणतेही वा य उ ारले, हणजे ‘मला आता काम आहे’, ‘मी चहा पणार आहे’, ‘कावळा उडू न आप या घरी गेला’, ‘साखर फार खाऊ नये’ यांतले काहीही, तरी तचा ठरलेला असतो ‘का ?’ मी ता पुरते काहीतरी उ र दे ऊन तला ग प बसवते; पण आप या उ राचा आवाका कती मया दत आहे. आ ण काही ांना उ रेच कशी नसतात, हे याचवेळ मला उमगते आ ण मी फार अ व होऊन जाते. छोट या या एका री ात जगात या सा या ज ासेचे, अनुभवाचे, ानाचे आ ण उ कट जा णवेचे मूळ सामावले आहे, याचा मला सा ा कार होतो. जगा या इ तहासात कोणाला तरी, के हा तरी, कशा या तरी संदभात ‘का ?’ असा वचारावासा वाटला. यातून शा े नमाण झाली. वै ा नक शोध लागले. आ या मक बोध झाला. सुंदर का ,े कलाकृ ती ु र या. हा ‘का ?’ जर आपण गमावून बसलो तर सारी गतीच थांबल े . आपण नेहमी वापरतो तो ‘वा !’ श द सकृ तदशनी तो कौतुकाचा उ ार वाटतो; पण जरा खोलवर वचार के ला तर तो दसतो ततका सो वळ नाही. चांगलाच लबाड आहे, हे यानात येते. कोणी नवी खरेद दाखवते, कोणी लेख कवा क वता वाचून यावरची त या वचारते, कोणी लेक चे गाणे ऐकवते, तर कोणी वकृ त पाक स खाऊ घालते. आ ण आपण मनातले भाव लपवत, येणारी जांभई आवरत त डदे खले ‘वा !’ हणत असतो. तो ‘वा !’ श द कं टाळा, नाराजी, उपे ा अशा कतीतरी भावना सू चत करतो. स यता सुसं कृ तता, ेमापोट पडणारी भीड अशा कती अडचणी आप या वाटे त उ या असतात आ ण या आप याला कौतुकाची दाद ायला लावून ‘वा !’ हणणे भाग. 17 | R17 ‘छे !’ हाही असाच एका री; परंतु अथाने ड गर पोटात सामावणारा श द. आ यं तक आ यापासून आ यं तक कृ त तेपयत, आ यं तक आनंदापासून तो पराका े या तु तेपयत कतीतरी पर र वरोधी त या या एकाच एका री उ ारातून आपण कट करत असतो. ‘परवा भीमसेनज ची मैफल ऐकली. छे ! कमाल के ली पं डतज नी या दवशी.’ या वा यातला ‘छे !’ कौतुकादर दाखवतो ‘छे ! कसलं घाणेरडं प चर दाखवलंस तू मला. वैताग आला ते बघताना !’ या वा यातला ‘छे !’ तु ता, तर कार यांचा सूचक असतो. ‘छे ! आ ही का ती मुलगी पसंत करणार आम या मुलासाठ ? काहीतरीच काय ?’ या वा यातला ‘छे !’ बोलणा या या कवा बोलणारी या अहंकारी आ तेमधून उमटलेला असतो. ‘छे ! छे !! कहर झाला अगद ! हसून हसून माझं पोट खायला लागलं,’ ही एखा ा सुंदर, वनोद नाटका लची उ ू त त या असते. असे कतीतरी एका री श द. ‘हं’, ‘रे’, ‘हो’, ‘छ ’ हेही या याच मा लके तले. मा , या श दां या उ ारा बरोबर वरांचा चढउतार, यातला सू म फरक, चेह यावरचे भाव हे यानी घेतले नाहीत, तर यांचा खरा अथ समजणारच नाही.

questions.question_en: Read the following passage and answer the questions 26 to 30. “Coral Reef Ecosystem” Coral require temperatures between 23°C to 25°C for their growth. The minimum temperature must not go below 18°C. This temperature requirement restricts their growth to tropical waters between 30° N and 30° S latitudes away from cold water currents. The diversity of coral reefs decrease in higher latitudes to about 30° N and 30° S latitudes. North or South of this zone, coral growth does not occur. However, corals lying in the path of northward moving warm water are an exception to this rule. The largest concentration occurs near the equator where water temperatures are highest. The main obstacle to coral growth in low latitudes along the east coast of oceans (west coast of continents) is the presence of cool water with a temperature lower than 18°C for at least part of the year. The exceptional occurrence of small reefs on the north eastern side of the pearl islands, Gulf of Panama results from a local absence of upwelling, whereas on the South western side coral growth is inhibited by cool upwelling caused by north easterly trade winds. Coral growth is locally hindered by summer cool upwelling in parts of the Somalian coast. 20 | R17 Between the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Aqaba the difference in coral growth is due to the Shamal, a cold north westerly wind blowing in winter over the northern part of the Persian Gulf so that temperature in that area is lowered to 15°C and sometimes to even 13.2°C on the Kuwait reefs. At high latitudes, such as Lord Howe Island, reef growth results from the East Australian warm current which flows from the coral sea to the Southern ocean; the Bermuda receive warm water flowing along the right hand side of the Gulf stream (19°C to 27°C); Southern Japanese Islands are favoured by the warm Kuroshio current (20°C – 28°C). The exceptional occurrence of Houtman’s Abrolhas, western Australia results from Leeuwin current which flows pole wards along this coast and carries warm equatorial pacific water around north west Australia.

No. 31 to Q. No. 35. After Gandhi’s comment on Hind Swaraj in 1908, the meaning of self-rule and self- determination continued and clarified. Once it was meant as independence or self governed country of the Indian people as a developed country; If many people understand India to be an international government, here ‘self’ means India and in this context, Swaraj means independence of India as a nation. In the Hind Swaraj, the difference is not expected only Kale Saheb instead of Gore Saheb. Gandhi would have seen the all-round emancipation of the Indian people. According to Gandhi’s opinion, every village would have to enjoy Swaraj or self- government; Though the roar of Lokmanya Tilak ‘Swaraj is my birthright and I will got it.’ spread the concept of Swaraj all over India. But Gandhi gave it a detailed, philosophic meaning. The method of understanding self-determination was interpreted in the Hind Swaraj. However, each use of this method starts a discussion like the earlier century. There were many contradictions within Gandhi’s own theory and in some incidents of his behavior led to many objections. Gandhi’s soft policy on criticisms of capitalism, caste system and religious practices were based on reality. Gandhi’s base method of thoughts of Swaraj was useful the beginning line for the rethinking of democratic revolution; we can follow this statement and the experience of last century the meaning of Swaraj has evolved into an all-inclusive freedom which is continuously making new orbit. In the agricultural struggle ‘Kasel Tyachi Zameen’ Swaraj got classified measurements. Here the full rainbow of ideologies from Gandhian to Marxist-Leninist is visible and the differences within each! The struggle of Indian democracy still discusses on the freedom of the landless, poor farm worker and unorganized workers and policies of it. Swaraj of the outcaste or Dalit and low-caste got central position in Indian political programme. Gandhiji’s Harijan Welfare Plan, Ambedkar’s Dalit Mukti Plan and combining the basic elements of both with the government’s policy of reservation has brought another innovative flow in the social transformation of contemporary India. The Swaraj concept for women was originated from the women’s education programme started in freedom movement by Gandhiji. In the last three decades, the Indian women’s movement has given a new height to the commentary on Indian democracy. It exposed the patriarchal dimensions of social structure, culture and the day today behaviour. Apart from this, the new principle of dominance and liberty was to formulated. So far, the methods of the unknown dominant ways the society have been suggested. In this way, a feminist theory would be a social theory. It is not only the analysing patriarchal system and does not fight against the state. It analyses all types of dominance and searches freedom in all fields. 24 | R17

Motors are devices that convert electrical energy to mechanical energy. Essentially, a motor is a generator operating in reverse. Instead of generating a current by rotating a loop, a current supplied to the loop causes it to rotate. Useful mechanical work can be done by attaching the rotating armature to some external device. However, as the loop rotates in a magnetic field, the changing magnetic flux induces an emf in the loop; this induced emf always acts to reduce the current in the loop. If this were not the case, Lenz’s law would be violated. The back emf increases in magnitude as the rotational speed of the armature increases. (The phrase back emf is used to indicate an emf that tends to reduce the supplied current.) Because the voltage available to supply current equals the difference between the supply voltage and the back emf, the current in the rotating coil is limited by the back emf. When a motor is turned on, there is initially no back emf; thus, the current is very large because it is limited only by the resistance of the coils. As the coils begin to * rotate, the induced back emf opposes the applied voltage, and the current in the coil is reduced. If the mechanical load increases, the motor slows down; this causes the back emf to decrease. This reduction in the back emf increases the current in the coils and therefore also increases the power needed from the external voltage source. For this reason, the power requirements for starting a motor and for running it are greater for heavy load than for light ones. If the motor is allowed to run under no mechanical load, the back emf reduces the current to a value just large enough to overcome energy losses due to internal energy and friction. If a very heavy load jams the motor so that it cannot rotate, the lack of a back emf can lead to dangerously high current in the motor’s wire. If the problem is not corrected, a fire could result.

State of the Indian Economy The last two years have been difficult for the world economy on account of the COVID-19 pandemic. Repeated waves of infection, supply-chain disruptions and more recently, inflation have created particularly challenging times for policy making. Faced with these challenges, the Government of India’s immediate response was a bouquet of safety nets to cushion the impact on vulnerable sections of society and the business sector. It next pushed through a significant increase in capital expenditure on infrastructure to build back medium-term demand as well as aggressively implemented supply side measures to prepare the economy for a sustained long-term expansion. Advance estimates suggest that the Indian economy is expected to witness real GDP expansion of 9.2 per cent in 2021-22 after contraction in it in 2020-21. This implies that overall economic activities have recovered past the pre-pandemic levels. Almost all indicators show that the economic impact of the “second wave” in Q1 was much smaller than that experienced during the full lockdown phase in 2020-21 even though the health impact was more severe. Agriculture and allied sectors have been least impacted by the pandemic and the sector is expected to grow by 3.9 per cent in 2021-22 after growing at 3.6 per cent in the previous year. Advance estimates suggest that the GVA of Industry (including mining and construction) will rise by 11.8 per cent in 2021-22 after contracting by 7 per cent in 2020-21. The service sector has been hit the hardest by the pandemic; especially segments that involve human contact. This sector is estimated to grow by 8.2 per cent this financial year following last year’s 8.4 per cent contraction. Total consumption is estimated to have grown by 7 per cent in 2021-22 with significant contributions from government spending. Similarly, Gross Fixed Capital Formation exceeded pre-pandemic levels on the back of ramped up public expenditure on infrastructure. Exports of both goods and services have been exceptionally strong so far in 2021-22, but imports also recovered strongly with recovery in domestic demand as well as higher international commodity prices. 31 | R17

Rala (Italian Millet), Sava (Little Millet), Harik (Vargu), Varai (Barnyard Millet) are rich in

amino acids, fatty acids and other vitamins. They contain minerals that are iron, calcium,

magnesium, phosphorus and potassium. These food components assist in the functioning of
hormones in the body. The amount of glucose and insulin produced in the body is controlled

by them. Since their digestion is slow, they stay in the stomach for a long time, so you get the
satisfaction of being full by eating less. They are high in lecithin which strengthens the

nervous system. Its phytochemicals reduce the risk of cancer. Blood cholesterol is reduced.
Whole grains provide 12.5% more protein than wheat. Sava is used in liver disorders. Since
millets are gluten-free, they can be consumed by people with gluten intolerance. In short,
whole grains are useful for body health due to various characteristics.

questions.option_3_en: People with congenital celiac sprue cannot digest gluten in their small intestine, so they have to eat foods where gluten is not detectable.
questions.option_4_en: Eating wheat is not inevitable as pulses, oil, milk, meat, fish, eggs, vegetables, fruits etc. are consumed along with jowar, bajri, rajgira, nachani, kuttu grains. 58 | R17

If wheat is completely excluded from food, the person does not get B-vitamins, zinc, bran, which are important elements along with gluten, and as a result, the beneficial bacteria in the intestines are depleted and the immunity of the intestine increases unbridled and rarely invites cancer.

अंधारात बाइकसवारी करताना मी पाठ मागचे दोन बाइक दवे वापरते. झळक या या तीत दो ही दवे हे नयं त के ले या
कालावधीनुसार आ ण कालांतरानुसार सतत का शत होतात. या व मे ुळे दो ही द ांचा न चमक याचा कालावधी कमी होतो

चमकतो आ ण नंतर एक सेकंद वझतो. सरा दवा दोन सेकंद चमकतो आ ण नंतर दोन सेकंद वझतो. बाइकसवारी या सु वातीला

नवडा.
questions.question_en:
I use two rear bike lamps, while riding my bike in the dark. They continuously emit light for a set period of
time at set intervals and thus both the lamps are in flashing mode. This arrangement reduces the amount of
time when neither of lamps shines, and that if one of the lamps stops flashing, I can still be visible to other
road users. One of the lamp shines for one second and goes dark for one second repeatedly; the other
lamp shines for two seconds and goes dark for two seconds. At the start of my ride, I always turn both
lamps on simultaneously.
Select the option that indicate seconds in each minute when neither of the lamps shine when they are in use.

सोबत या तमा 'Way To Go' या खेळात वापर या जाणा या दशां कत फाशाची तीन प र े य त पत करतात. जुजबी
सामा य ान ांची उ रे दे णे आ ण फलकावर स गट हलव यासाठ दोन फासे फे कणे या कृ त नी हा खेळ बनलेला असतो. एक
फासा सामा य असतो. सरा दशा फासा कोण या दशेने जायचे याचे नदशन करतो. फाशा या पाच पृ ांपैक येकावर एके क
बाणां या खुणा असून सहा ा पृ ावर खेळाडू ला नवडीला उपल असले या दशा दाखवणारे चार बाण आहेत.
पुढ लपैक दशा फाशाचे अ य प र े य दाखवणारी तमा नवडा.
questions.question_en:
Accompanying images represent three views of direction die which is used to play 'Way To Go'. The game
is composed of answering trivial questions of general knowledge and throwing two dice in order to move a
piece around a board. One of the dice is an ordinary die. The other one is a direction die, indicating which
way to go. Five of the faces of die are marked with a single arrow on each of them, whilst the sixth face has
a four-way arrow, giving the player a choice of direction.
Select one of the following that is another view of the direction die.

questions.subject: General Studies
questions.question_mr:

भाऊ आहे. R हा P या काकाचा कवा मामाचा एकु लता एक मुलगा आहे, याची एकमेव बहीण ही U ची आई आहे. R या व डलांना
भाऊ आहे याला Q व S या मुली आहेत.
या मा हती या संदभात स य वधान/ने नवडा.
वधाने :
a. S ही P ची चुलत कवा मामे बहीण आहे.
b. सव सद यांचे पालक ही भावंडे आहेत.
c. T ही न तपणे कु टुंबाचा पु ष सद य आहे.
d. Q व U या पर रां या मामे वा आते ब हणी आहेत.
questions.question_en:
Six family members P, Q, R, S, T and U have gathered for enjoying vacation. U is sister of T who has a
brother P. R is the one and only son of P's uncle, who's only sister is U's mother. R's father has a brother
who has daughters Q and S.
Select the true statement/s with respect to this information.
Statements:
a. S is cousin sister of P.
b. Parents of all members are siblings.
c. It is definite that T is a male member of the family.
d. Q and U are cousin sisters.
